solves.reasoning: (A) formed and processed → processed. (B) defined as the balance → balance. (C) would not be capable → capable.
(A) constantly strive → strive. (B) effective compensatory → effective. (C) capable of surviving → surviving.
(A) heavily reliant → reliant. (B) must correspondingly fall → correspondingly. (C) essential component → essential.
③ lightly는 원문 heavily의 반의어. 서로에게 가볍게 의존한다는 것은 부적절.
① amplify는 원문 cushion의 반의어. 극단을 증폭하면 생존 불가.
④ embrace는 원문 escape의 반의어. 비참함을 수용하려 한다면 결론과 모순.
strive for _____, defined as the balance of bodily functions → homeostasis.
effective _____ mechanisms which may cushion potential highs and lows → compensatory.
allowing it will in turn _____ our internal scale back to balance → reset.
strive(노력하다) ≈ endeavor(노력하다). hesitate/decline/retreat는 모두 반대 뉘앙스.
maintain(유지하다) ≈ sustain(유지하다). release/abandon/disrupt는 반의어.
attempts(시도) ≈ efforts(노력). achievements/failures/commands는 무관.
potential(잠재적) ↔ actual(실제). hopeful/promising/likely는 유의어 쪽.
neutral(중립적) ↔ biased(편향된). objective/moderate/calm은 반의어가 아님.
(A) escape chronic pain = 벗어나다(동사). (B) planned a daring escape = 탈출(명사).
a part of a larger whole, especially a machine/system → component. element는 기계 특화 부족.
which is _____(define) as → 수동태 is defined as. 과거분사.
_____(allow) it will in turn reset → 동명사 주어. allowing it = 그것을 허용하는 것이.
like _____; they work together and are reliant → two sides of the same coin.
and _____ our internal scale back to balance → allowing it will in turn reset.
